read.thesis: UBS Q3 underlying PBT $3.6bn (+50%) incl. $668m litigation releases; ex-litigation ROCET1 12.7%, 2026 buyback to be accrued in Q4 and size still undetermined, IB Q4 guided to normalise from record Q3.

triggers.label: IB Q4 banking to normalise
triggers.quote: For the fourth quarter, we expect banking activity to normalize from Q3's exceptional levels.

triggers.label: 2026 buyback to be accrued in Q4
triggers.quote: we expect our year-end 2025 CET1 capital ratio to decrease sequentially, driven by an accrual for intended share repurchases in 2026

triggers.label: APAC net new assets $38bn
triggers.quote: exceptional inflows in Asia Pacific, which alone contributed $38 billion

triggers.label: Americas NNA negative $9bn
triggers.quote: Net new assets in the Americas were negative $9 billion

triggers.label: Cost saves $10bn, a quarter early
triggers.quote: the cumulative total reaching the $10 billion mark, 1 quarter ahead of schedule

guidance.quote: we expect net interest income to be broadly stable sequentially
we expect CLE to be around CHF 80 million
For the fourth quarter, we expect banking activity to normalize from Q3's exceptional levels.
we expect our year-end 2025 CET1 capital ratio to decrease sequentially

prior_guidance_check.quote: we remain on track to complete the final migrations by the end of the first quarter next year

prior_guidance_check.metric: Full year 2025 return on CET1 about 10%
prior_guidance_check.quote: our return was 11%, above our full year guidance of around 10%

red_flags.label: Litigation releases flatter underlying profit
red_flags.quote: Included in our underlying performance are net litigation reserve releases of $668 million

red_flags.label: AT1 write-down appeal and legal exposure
red_flags.quote: we feel that it's important that we participate to bring to bear the best possible outcome

red_flags.label: Americas adviser attrition
red_flags.quote: adviser movement following the structural changes we introduced last year
